newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends at 1,040.10, up for 4th day.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends at 1,040.10, up for 4th day.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed higher for the fourth consecutive day as dollar sales by oil exporters helped push it to its highest close since August 23.
"Oil export companies were selling good quantities of dollars," one dealer said of the peso's rise in Friday's interbank session.
He said the peso, which traded in a 1,039.20 to 1,041.95 range, closed at 1,040.10, up 2.40 pesos against the dollar from Thursday's close.
Dealers reported 286 trades for a total of $127.5 million.
